clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Formally Resigns As Indonesian Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially resigned from his position after submitting a formal letter to the People's Consultative Assembly.
President Prabowo Subianto has formally accepted the resignation, expressing gratitude for the service rendered during the term.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Addresses Vice President Gibran Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto formally accepted the resignation of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Government officials confirmed that national administration remains stable following the unexpected departure.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Initiates Selection Of New Indonesian Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has formally resigned from his position.
President Prabowo Subianto is currently consulting with coalition political parties to nominate two candidates for the vacancy.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Investigate Illegal Surveillance Case Against Prabowo
aiSummaryBullets: National Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto detailed a five-stage operation involving the illegal surveillance of President Prabowo Subianto.
Four police generals are currently detained in connection with the case, while one senior officer has been placed under house arrest.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Office Following Degree Revocation
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education has officially revoked the diploma equivalence certificate issued to Gibran Rakabuming Raka.
Following the ministry's administrative decision, Gibran Rakabuming Raka announced his resignation from the position of Vice President.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Indonesian Vice Presidency Role
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially resigned from his post as the Vice President of Indonesia.
The outgoing official met with President Prabowo Subianto at the Presidential Palace to finalize his departure.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Office
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has formally resigned from his position of his own volition.
The resignation has resulted in the immediate termination of the impeachment proceedings previously initiated in the House of Representatives.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Resigns From Post
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka stepped down following public scrutiny over his overseas education credentials.
The resignation is linked to reports that a submitted certificate failed to confirm his equivalence to a local vocational high school diploma.

clusters.headline: Megawati Advocates For Household Waste Sorting To Ease Landfill Load
aiSummaryBullets: Megawati Soekarnoputri encourages Jakarta residents to perform waste sorting at the source to alleviate the burden on the Bantargebang landfill.
The initiative aims to facilitate circular economy practices and potentially improve the welfare of waste collectors.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Resigns Canceling Impeachment Vote
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially stepped down from his office.
The Indonesian House of Representatives canceled a scheduled plenary session regarding an impeachment motion.
